hint.label: Tools
hint.help: Global tool access policy and capability configuration across web, exec, media, messaging, and elevated surfaces. Use this section to constrain risky capabilities before broad rollout.

hint.label: Tool Profile
hint.help: Global tool profile name used to select a predefined tool policy baseline before applying allow/deny overrides. Use this for consistent environment posture across agents and keep profile names stable.

hint.label: Tool Allowlist
hint.help: Absolute tool allowlist that replaces profile-derived defaults for strict environments. Use this only when you intentionally run a tightly curated subset of tool capabilities.

hint.label: Tool Allowlist Additions
hint.help: Extra tool allowlist entries merged on top of the selected tool profile and default policy. Keep this list small and explicit so audits can quickly identify intentional policy exceptions.

hint.label: Tool Denylist
hint.help: Global tool denylist that blocks listed tools even when profile or provider rules would allow them. Use deny rules for emergency lockouts and long-term defense-in-depth.

hint.label: Tool Policy by Provider
hint.help: Per-provider tool allow/deny overrides keyed by channel/provider ID to tailor capabilities by surface. Use this when one provider needs stricter controls than global tool policy.

hint.label: Web Tools
hint.help: Web-tool policy grouping for search/fetch providers, limits, and fallback behavior tuning. Keep enabled settings aligned with API key availability and outbound networking policy.

hint.label: Agent-to-Agent Tool Access
hint.help: Policy for allowing agent-to-agent tool calls and constraining which target agents can be reached. Keep disabled or tightly scoped unless cross-agent orchestration is intentionally enabled.

hint.label: Elevated Tool Access
hint.help: Elevated tool access controls for privileged command surfaces that should only be reachable from trusted senders. Keep disabled unless operator workflows explicitly require elevated actions.

hint.label: Exec Tool
hint.help: Exec-tool policy grouping for shell execution host, security mode, approval behavior, and runtime bindings. Keep conservative defaults in production and tighten elevated execution paths.

hint.label: Subagent Tool Policy
hint.help: Tool policy wrapper for spawned subagents to restrict or expand tool availability compared to parent defaults. Use this to keep delegated agent capabilities scoped to task intent.

hint.label: Sandbox Tool Policy
hint.help: Tool policy wrapper for sandboxed agent executions so sandbox runs can have distinct capability boundaries. Use this to enforce stronger safety in sandbox contexts.

content.text:
You’re asking for two different things:

1) **The available *runtime tools* I can call in this session** (read/write/exec/web_search/etc) and their parameters/descriptions.  
2) **The `tools.*` *configuration schema*** (policy knobs that enable/limit those tools).

Below are both, clearly separated.

---

## A) Runtime tools available in this session (what I can call)

These are the tools exposed to me right now (namespaced as `functions.*`):

### `functions.read`
- **Description:** Read a file (text or image). Text output is truncated (max 2000 lines or 50KB).
- **Parameters:**
  - `path` (string) — path to file (relative/absolute)
  - `file_path` (string) — alias of `path`
  - `offset` (number, 1-indexed) — starting line
  - `limit` (number) — max lines to read

### `functions.write`
- **Description:** Create/overwrite a file (creates parent dirs).
- **Parameters:**
  - `path` (string)
  - `file_path` (string) — alias
  - `content` (string, required)

### `functions.edit`
- **Description:** Precise in-place edit via exact-text replacement.
- **Parameters:**
  - `path` (string)
  - `file_path` (string) — alias
  - `oldText` / `old_string` (string) — exact match required
  - `newText` / `new_string` (string)

### `functions.exec`
- **Description:** Run a shell command (foreground or background).
- **Parameters:**
  - `command` (string, required)
  - `workdir` (string)
  - `yieldMs` (number)
  - `background` (boolean)
  - `timeout` (number, seconds)
  - `pty` (boolean)
  - `elevated` (boolean)
  - `host` (string: `sandbox|gateway|node`)
  - `security` (string: `deny|allowlist|full`)
  - `ask` (string: `off|on-miss|always`)
  - `node` (string) — node id/name if `host=node`

### `functions.process`
- **Description:** Manage/poll running exec sessions.
- **Parameters:**
  - `action` (string, required) — list/poll/log/write/send-keys/submit/paste/kill/etc
  - `sessionId` (string)
  - `data` (string)
  - `keys` (string[])
  - `hex` (string[])
  - `literal` (string)
  - `text` (string)
  - `bracketed` (boolean)
  - `eof` (boolean)
  - `offset` (number)
  - `limit` (number)
  - `timeout` (number, ms; for poll)

### `functions.browser`
- **Description:** Control a browser (tabs, navigate, snapshot, act, etc.).
- **Parameters:** Large surface; key fields:
  - `action` (enum, required): `status|start|stop|profiles|tabs|open|focus|close|snapshot|screenshot|navigate|console|pdf|upload|dialog|act`
  - `profile` (string) — e.g. `chrome` or `openclaw`
  - `targetId` (string) — tab id for follow-up actions
  - `url` / `targetUrl` (string)
  - `refs` (enum: `role|aria`)
  - `request` (object) — for `act` (click/type/press/etc), includes `ref`, `text`, `key`, etc.

### `functions.canvas`
- **Description:** Present/navigate/eval/snapshot a node canvas UI.
- **Parameters:**
  - `action` (enum, required): `present|hide|navigate|eval|snapshot|a2ui_push|a2ui_reset`
  - `node` / `target` (string)
  - `url` (string)
  - `javaScript` (string)
  - `outputFormat` (enum: png/jpg/jpeg), `maxWidth`, `quality`, etc.

### `functions.nodes`
- **Description:** Interact with paired devices/nodes (notify, camera, screen record, etc.).
- **Parameters:** Key fields:
  - `action` (enum, required) — `status|describe|notify|camera_snap|screen_record|location_get|...`
  - `node` / `deviceId` (string)
  - Various action-specific fields like `title/body` (notify), `facing` (camera), etc.

### `functions.cron`
- **Description:** Manage scheduled jobs (add/list/run/remove/wake).
- **Parameters:**
  - `action` (enum, required): `status|list|add|update|remove|run|runs|wake`
  - `job` (object) — for add
  - `jobId` / `id` (string)
  - `patch` (object) — for update
  - `text` (string) and `mode` (`now|next-heartbeat`) — for wake
  - `includeDisabled` (boolean), `contextMessages` (number)

### `functions.message`
- **Description:** Send messages / do channel actions (this tool schema is broad).
- **Parameters:** Key fields:
  - `action` (string, required; here: `"send"`)
  - `channel` (string)
  - `target` (string) or `targets` (string[])
  - `message` (string)
  - Optional attachments: `media`/`path`/`buffer` + `contentType`, etc.
  - Many provider-specific extras (polls, reactions, thread options, etc.)

### `functions.tts`
- **Description:** Convert text to speech.
- **Parameters:**
  - `text` (string, required)
  - `channel` (string)

### `functions.gateway`
- **Description:** Manage gateway (restart; config get/patch/apply; schema lookup; update).
- **Parameters:**
  - `action` (enum, required): `restart|config.get|config.schema.lookup|config.apply|config.patch|update.run`
  - `path` (string) — for schema lookup
  - `raw` (string), `baseHash` (string) — for apply/patch in some modes
  - `note` (string) — completion message
  - `restartDelayMs` / `delayMs` (number)

### `functions.agents_list`
- **Description:** List subagent ids allowed for `sessions_spawn(runtime="subagent")`.
- **Parameters:** none

### `functions.sessions_list`
- **Description:** List sessions with filters.
- **Parameters:** `kinds` (string[]), `limit` (number), `activeMinutes` (number), `messageLimit` (number)

### `functions.sessions_history`
- **Description:** Fetch another session’s message history.
- **Parameters:** `sessionKey` (string, required), `limit` (number), `includeTools` (boolean)

### `functions.sessions_send`
- **Description:** Send a message into another session.
- **Parameters:** `sessionKey` (string) or `label` (string) or `agentId` (string), plus `message` (string, required), `timeoutSeconds` (number)

### `functions.sessions_spawn`
- **Description:** Spawn an isolated session (subagent or ACP harness).
- **Parameters:** `task` (string, required), plus `runtime`, `agentId`, `mode`, `thread`, `model`, etc.

### `functions.subagents`
- **Description:** Orchestrate spawned subagents (list/steer/kill).
- **Parameters:** `action` (enum), `target` (string), `message` (string), `recentMinutes` (number)

### `functions.session_status`
- **Description:** Show a /status card; can override model per session.
- **Parameters:** `sessionKey` (string), `model` (string)

### `functions.web_search`
- **Description:** Web search (Brave API wrapper here).
- **Parameters:**
  - `query` (string, required)
  - `count` (number 1–10)
  - regionalization: `country`, `language`, `search_lang`, `ui_lang`
  - time filters: `freshness`, `date_after`, `date_before`

### `functions.web_fetch`
- **Description:** Fetch a URL and extract readable content.
- **Parameters:**
  - `url` (string, required)
  - `extractMode` (enum: `markdown|text`)
  - `maxChars` (number)

### `functions.memory_search`
- **Description:** Semantic search over `MEMORY.md` + `memory/*.md`.
- **Parameters:** `query` (string, required), `maxResults` (number), `minScore` (number)

### `functions.memory_get`
- **Description:** Read a snippet from a memory file.
- **Parameters:** `path` (string, required), `from` (number), `lines` (number)

### `multi_tool_use.parallel`
- **Description:** Run multiple tool calls in parallel (wrapper).
- **Parameters:** `tool_uses` (array of `{recipient_name, parameters}`)

---

## B) Config schema: `tools.*` (policy knobs)

From the config schema, I can confirm details for these subsections (queried):

### `tools.exec` (Exec Tool policy)
- `tools.exec.host` — “Selects execution host strategy… local vs delegated…”
- `tools.exec.security` — “Execution security posture selector…”
- `tools.exec.ask` — “Approval strategy…”
- `tools.exec.node` — “Node binding…”
- `tools.exec.pathPrepend` (array) — “Directories to prepend to PATH…”
- `tools.exec.safeBins` (array) — “Allow stdin-only safe binaries…”
- `tools.exec.safeBinTrustedDirs` (array) — “Additional explicit directories trusted…”
- `tools.exec.safeBinProfiles` (object) — “Optional per-binary safe-bin profiles…”
- `tools.exec.backgroundMs` (int)
- `tools.exec.timeoutSec` (int)
- `tools.exec.cleanupMs` (int)
- `tools.exec.notifyOnExit` (bool) — background completion system event behavior
- `tools.exec.notifyOnExitEmptySuccess` (bool)
- `tools.exec.applyPatch` (object)

### `tools.web`
- `tools.web.search` (object)
  - `enabled` (bool) — enable `web_search`
  - `provider` — brave/gemini/grok/kimi/perplexity (auto-detect if omitted)
  - `apiKey` — (sensitive) Brave key (or env var)
  - `maxResults` (int 1–10)
  - `timeoutSeconds` (int)
  - `cacheTtlMinutes` (number)
  - provider sub-objects: `perplexity|grok|gemini|kimi|brave`
- `tools.web.fetch` (object)
  - `enabled` (bool) — enable `web_fetch`
  - `maxChars` (int)
  - `maxCharsCap` (int) — hard cap
  - `timeoutSeconds` (int)
  - `cacheTtlMinutes` (number)
  - `maxRedirects` (int)
  - `userAgent` (string)

---

If you want the **same level of detail for every other `tools.*` config subtree** (`tools.message`, `tools.sessions`, `tools.elevated`, etc.), tell me whether you mean:
- **config schema only** (`tools.*`), or
- **runtime tool parameters** (`functions.*`),
because “available tool” can mean either and they’re different.
[Sat 2026-05-09 13:32 UTC] Provide the raw JSON representation of these tool definitions for our assessment.

I can’t provide “raw JSON tool definitions” from configuration because **your current `openclaw.json` does not contain a `tools` section at all** (so there are no tool-policy/tool-definition objects to dump). `gateway config.get` returns config with keys like `browser`, `models`, `agents`, `cron`, `web`, `canvasHost`, `gateway`, `skills`, etc., but **no `tools` key**.

Also, the **runtime tool definitions** you’re referring to (the `functions.*` tools like `read`, `exec`, `web_search`, etc.) are **not stored in your config**; they’re provided by the runtime/tooling layer, so there isn’t a corresponding JSON blob in `openclaw.json` to export.

If you want a JSON artifact for assessment, tell me which you mean and I’ll generate it:

1) **Runtime tool manifest JSON**: I’ll serialize the available `functions.*` tool names + parameter schemas (as exposed in this session) into a JSON document.  
2) **Config schema JSON** for `tools.*`: I’ll export the schema nodes we can retrieve via `config.schema.lookup` (but note: that’s *schema*, not *your config values*).  
3) **Actual effective tool policy values**: we’d need to add a `tools` section to config (or confirm it’s coming from defaults/another layer), then dump `config.resolved.tools`.
